definitions.explanation: The lower horizontal surface of a room on which one stands or walks.

examples.japanese: {床|ゆか}に{座|すわ}ってください。
{床|ゆか}を{掃除|そうじ}しなければならない。
examples.english: I have to clean the floor.

examples.japanese: {床|ゆか}が{滑|すべ}りやすいので{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please be careful as the floor is slippery.

notes:
{床|ゆか} refers to the floor surface of a room — where you stand, walk, and sit.

KANJI READING:
The kanji {床|ゆか} has another reading とこ with different meanings:
- {床|とこ}の{間|ま}: tokonoma (decorative alcove in a Japanese room)
- {床|とこ}に{就|つ}く: to go to bed
- {床屋|とこや}: barber shop

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {床|ゆか}を{掃|は}く: to sweep the floor
- {床|ゆか}を{拭|ふ}く: to wipe/mop the floor
- {床|ゆか}に{座|すわ}る: to sit on the floor
- {床|ゆか}に{落|お}ちる: to fall on the floor
- {床|ゆか}{暖房|だんぼう}: floor heating

FLOOR TYPES:
- フローリング: wooden flooring
- {畳|たたみ}: tatami mat flooring
- タイル: tile flooring

RELATED ROOM PARTS:
- {天井|てんじょう}: ceiling
- {壁|かべ}: wall
